parameters.query:
SELECT chunk_id, doc_title, heading_path, page_from, raw_content
FROM nlq.search_knowledge(
  $1::text,
  $2::vector,
  $3::int,                      -- p_limit
  40,                           -- p_candidates  (§3.4 default)
  50,                           -- p_rrf_k       (§3.4 default)
  'bge-m3',
  NULLIF($4::text, '')          -- p_doc_type; '' means the whole corpus
);
